title: Back To The Ol' Fade Factory
description: Back To The Ol' Fade Factory — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Mutantos

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay 35 Shadow Fade Factory Workers and 7 Shadow Fade Factory Foremen in the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Ex-Soldier Bubba in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Mutantos

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Slay 35 Shadow Fade Factory Workers and 7 Shadow Fade Factory Foremen in the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Ex-Soldier Bubba in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Offer:

It doesn't get any simpler than this: Kill more Shadow Fade Factory Workers and Foremen. We won't be happy until the cutbacks result in the complete annihilation of Fades. Then maybe we can bring in some cheaper labor to use those factories for something other than just polluting. Don't get me wrong, pollution has its benefits, but it makes a better byproduct than a product!

Kill the Shadow Fade Factory Workers and Shadow Fade Factory Foremen and return to me, Ex-Soldier Bubba, here in the Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp for your reward.

Turn-in:

Well done. I can actually see the smog emanating from Algor's Terror-Dome dispersing. Talk to me when you are ready to continue the cutbacks.

Objectives:

  • Slain Shadow Fade Factory Worker
  • Slain Shadow Fade Factory Foremen

Client level range: 15–30
